$comment: WHERE THE ENGINE KEEPS ITS OWN THINGS, declared once. Repository-relative paths, resolved against the engine root. Extracted 2026-08-17: three TypeScript files each spelled the template directory as a hardcoded relative walk from __dirname, with three DIFFERENT level counts — every one correct from src/ and wrong from the compiled bundle, which is one level down. Each resolved above the repository at runtime and threw ENOENT; it cost three consecutive launches. A path written into engine code is a fact the engine cannot be told, and this is the file it is told in.
$overrideComment: Every entry may be overridden by the matching environment variable, for a packaged install that lays the engine out differently. An override is taken as absolute if it is, otherwise resolved against the engine root.

promptTemplates.$what: The immutable prompt template layer. Every agent prompt in the pipeline is rendered from a JSON file here.
